{{Top|leg}}
'''Harvester stations''' were underwater harvesting facilities used by the [[Seacroppers' Guild]] of [[Aquilaris Minor|Aquilaris]] around [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]]. They were used to harvest large [[Algae/Legends|algae]] on the ocean floors of that world. By the [[Aquilaris campaign]], most of them were run-down and decrepit due to war damage. However, they were used to house refugees during and after the [[Great Aquilaris Deluge]].
